originalTitle: GE Vernova and ATI shares are soaring, what you need to know
summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after U.S. stocks climbed across the board as investors positioned for an eventful week defined by a key Federal Reserve interest rate announcement and high-profile corporate earnings releases.
content:
A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after U.S. stocks climbed across the board as investors positioned for an eventful week defined by a key Federal Reserve interest rate announcement and high-profile corporate earnings releases.

Morningstar reported that roughly 36% of S&P 500 companies—including technology heavyweights Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft—are scheduled to report their quarterly results this week. Concurrently, the Federal Reserve is scheduled to announce its latest monetary policy decision on Wednesday, with money markets assigning a 90% probability that the central bank will leave the Fed Funds rate on hold, according to Morningstar.

Despite traders juggling fresh Middle East conflicts and artificial-intelligence valuation worries, Morningstar noted that anticipation surrounding resilient corporate health helped lift benchmark futures into positive territory. Morningstar highlighted data indicating that analysts expect S&P 500 companies to report a massive 30% jump in third-quarter earnings compared to a year ago.

Furthermore, Morningstar cited commentary from BondBloxx Investment Management suggesting that the market views this week's expected Fed hold as merely a temporary pause rather than the definitive end of the tightening cycle. Ultimately, Morningstar explained that falling Treasury yields in the run-up to Wednesday's central bank decision provided further support for the broader equity rally prior to the opening bell.

The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.

Among others, the following stocks were impacted:

Electrical systems company GE Vernova(NYSE:GEV) jumped 5.5%. Is now the time to buy GE Vernova? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

Aerospace company ATI(NYSE:ATI) jumped 5.4%. Is now the time to buy ATI? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

GE Vernova's shares are very volatile and have had 28 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today's move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 20 days ago when the stock gained 5% on the news that surging capital spending for artificial intelligence infrastructure and defense bolstered demand across power systems, data center construction, and electrical grid buildouts, with gains amplified as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite reached fresh all-time highs.

Capital allocations directed toward artificial intelligence facilities have intensified demand across the industrials sector, as massive computing clusters require extensive power upgrades and physical installations as reported by AP news. Companies providing electrical grid equipment, backup generation, and specialized data center construction are seeing accelerated project orders. Power supply constraints have become a focal challenge for tech infrastructure development, turning industrial suppliers into critical enablers of technology adoption.

Meanwhile, sustained government and corporate budgets for defense modernization provide an additional pillar of predictable revenue. Analysts note that these dual infrastructure drivers have helped insulate power systems and industrial equipment providers from broader macroeconomic cyclicality, reinforcing market momentum as investors anticipate continued multi-year order backlogs across the sector.

GE Vernova is up 26.7% since the beginning of the year, but at $861.31 per share, it is still trading 26.7% below its 52-week high of $1,175 from June 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of GE Vernova's shares at the IPO in March 2024 would now be looking at an investment worth $6,561.

chineseTitle: GE Vernova和ATI股价飙升，你需要知道什么
chineseSummary: 由于投资者准备迎接美联储关键利率公告和备受瞩目的企业财报发布所定义的多事之周，美国股市全线上涨，许多股票在下午交易中上涨。
chineseContent:
由于投资者准备迎接美联储关键利率公告和备受瞩目的企业财报发布所定义的多事之周，美国股市全线上涨，许多股票在下午交易中上涨。

晨星报告称，大约 36% 的标准普尔 500 指数公司（包括科技巨头亚马逊、Alphabet 和微软）计划于本周公布季度业绩。与此同时，据晨星公司称，美联储定于周三宣布最新货币政策决定，货币市场认为美联储维持联邦基金利率不变的可能性为 90%。

尽管交易员要应对新的中东冲突和人工智能估值担忧，但晨星指出，围绕弹性企业健康状况的预期有助于将基准期货推向正值。晨星公司强调的数据表明，分析师预计标准普尔 500 指数公司第三季度盈利将比一年前大幅增长 30%。

此外，晨星公司援引BondBloxx投资管理公司的评论称，市场认为本周美联储的预期只是暂时暂停，而不是紧缩周期的最终结束。最终，晨星公司解释说，在周三央行决定之前，国债收益率的下降为开盘前更广泛的股市反弹提供了进一步的支持。

股市对消息反应过度，价格大幅下跌可能是购买优质股票的好机会。

其中，以下股票受到影响：

电气系统公司 GE Vernova（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GEV）上涨 5.5%。现在是购买 GE Vernova 的时候吗？在这里访问我们的完整分析报告，它是免费的。

航空航天公司 ATI（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ATI）上涨 5.4%。现在是购买 ATI 的时候吗？在这里访问我们的完整分析报告，它是免费的。

GE Vernova 的股价波动很大，去年有 28 次涨幅超过 5%。在这种背景下，今天的举动表明市场认为这一消息有意义，但不会从根本上改变其对该业务的看法。

我们之前写到的大动作是在 20 天前，当时该股上涨 5%，原因是人工智能基础设施和国防资本支出激增，提振了电力系统、数据中心建设和电网扩建的需求，随着标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克综合指数创下历史新高，涨幅进一步扩大。

据美联社报道，针对人工智能设施的资本配置加剧了整个工业领域的需求，因为大规模计算集群需要广泛的电力升级和物理安装。提供电网设备、备用发电和专业数据中心建设的公司的项目订单正在加速增长。电力供应限制已成为技术基础设施发展的主要挑战，使工业供应商成为技术采用的关键推动者。

与此同时，用于国防现代化的持续政府和企业预算提供了可预测收入的另一个支柱。分析师指出，这些双重基础设施驱动因素有助于使电力系统和工业设备提供商免受更广泛的宏观经济周期性的影响，从而增强了市场动力，因为投资者预计整个行业将持续多年订单积压。

GE Vernova 自今年年初以来上涨了 26.7%，但每股 861.31 美元，仍比 2026 年 6 月以来的 52 周高点 1,175 美元低 26.7%。在 2024 年 3 月 IPO 中购买了价值 1,000 美元的 GE Vernova 股票的投资者现在将考虑价值 6,561 美元的投资。
